school: University of Maine at Presque Isle
scope: Internal policy research only. No curriculum, numeric cap, availability flag or student state changed. Primary institution/provider sources only.

sources.title: YourPace Student Handbook 2025–2026
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: Incoming transfer can exceed 90, but no more than 90 credits apply to the degree.
ACE courses appear among CPL methods.
The combined bachelor CPL maximum is 30 credits; the associate maximum is 15.
sources.dateCaution: The printed edition is 2025–2026. Its upload path is not an independently established adoption date for a new policy.

sources.title: Current UMPI Credit for Prior Learning options and process
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: ACE-recommended courses from non-accredited training organizations are expressly included among CPL methods.
The combined bachelor CPL maximum is 30 credits; the associate maximum is 15.
sources.dateCaution: The current public page is undated; no claim is made about its first adoption date or automatic cohort grandfathering.

sources.title: UMPI American Council on Education credit pathway
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: ACE coursework, training and exams are submitted for CPL/PLA consideration.
The page does not state an approved-source exception allowing 90 ACE credits.

sources.title: UMPI current CPL process
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: The combination of all forms of PLA is limited to 30 bachelor credits and 15 associate credits.

sources.title: Current UMPI YourPace FAQ
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: There is no fixed incoming transfer limit; course applicability remains degree-specific.
Bachelor residency is 30 UMPI credits, including 12 in the major, with nine of those at the 300 level or above.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The FAQ does not grant 90 ACE/Sophia credits or state that CPL has no separate cap.

sources.title: Current UMPI Office of Student Records transfer policies
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: General transfer policy recognizes applicable institutionally accredited coursework and ACE credit.
It separately directs students with non-recognized institutional coursework to testing or approved CPL processes.
Residency and program distribution requirements still apply.
sources.doesNotEstablish: No express YourPace exception for 90 ACE credits is printed here.

sources.title: Sophia UMPI partner course table
facts: Sophia states that UMPI has teamed with it and publishes named and elective receiving equivalents.
The page instructs learners to request a Parchment transcript after completing their planned Sophia coursework.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The provider page does not state an overall 90-credit ACE allowance or a school policy exception to CPL 30.

sources.title: Official UMPI course catalogue 2018–2019
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: The historical catalog already groups ACE recommendations with PLA methods and states a combined 30-credit bachelor limit.
sources.dateCaution: Historical continuity evidence only. The 2024 upload path does not make this a 2024 policy or a current catalog.

sources.title: Current YourPace student resources
sources.publisher: University of Maine at Presque Isle
facts: Current YourPace student resources describe CPL as a YourPace option and provide a CPL information link.
sources.dateCaution: No 2026–2027 replacement handbook or explicit alternative-credit cap exception was located in this bounded review.

conclusion.basis: The current official CPL page expressly includes ACE and limits combined CPL to 30 bachelor credits. Its ACE subpage routes ACE transcripts through CPL/PLA. The YourPace FAQ allows general transfer subject to 30 UMPI residency credits; it does not remove a separate source-type ceiling. These rules can coexist. An official YourPace exception or cohort-specific superseding policy was not found.
conclusion.strongestPublishedReading: For a new plan, do not infer eligibility for 90 ACE/Sophia credits from the 90-credit overall outside ceiling. The published CPL 30 rule is material until an official YourPace clarification establishes otherwise.
notEstablished: Whether UMPI administratively classifies existing approved Sophia/Study.com equivalencies outside the CPL cap.
Whether any YourPace cohort has a formally adopted exemption or grandfathering rule.
The effective date of any change to the written CPL 30 policy or a narrower actual practice.

ruleSeparation.incomingTranscriptCreditLimit: No fixed numeric limit on incoming records is stated.

bachelorDegreeOutsideCeilingFromResidenc.basis: A 120-credit degree with 30 required UMPI credits; exact program residency and degree requirements still apply.

publishedCombinedCPLLimit.scopeCaution: The current generic policy and the 2025–2026 YourPace handbook both support this reading. No 2026–2027 cohort-specific superseding document was retrieved.

ruleSeparation.approvedCourseEquivalency: A named receiving equivalency can be published while aggregate CPL and residency restrictions still limit how much applies.
ruleSeparation.institutionIssuedOutsideCredit: Original accredited-college coursework requires a separate origin and transfer analysis. Do not relabel ACE learning as original institutional coursework solely because a transcript service or another college lists it.

institutionClarificationNeeded.studentRecordsStillPersonal: Preserve existing written university evaluations for individual learners; this research does not revoke already awarded credit.

recommendedPlatformHandling: Keep the 90-credit overall outside ceiling and the published 30-credit CPL quantity separate; do not claim a 90-credit Sophia plan is confirmed.
Keep this as internal policy work rather than a generic verify-everything checklist for students.
Continue exact course/GLO mapping independently, but do not release a route that depends on more than 30 alternative credits until the relevant school policy is resolved.
